question:
A nuclear reactor produces a steady thermal power of $P=100\,\text{MW}$. Assume each fission releases $200\,\text{MeV}$ of energy.

Take $1\,\text{eV}=1.602\times 10^{-19}\,\text{J}$ and mass of one $^{235}\text{U}$ nucleus as $235u$ with $1u=1.6605\times 10^{-27}\,\text{kg}$.

(a) Find the number of fissions per second.</br>
(b) Estimate the mass of $^{235}\text{U}$ consumed in one day.</br>
